nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documentation for the @waggle/hive-mind-hooks-openclaw package, describing how it registers in-process TypeScript hooks into the OpenClaw gateway to silently capture conversation lifecycle events (bootstrap, message:received, message:sent, compact:before) into hive-mind frames, including install/uninstall instructions, capture fidelity table, and known limitations.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for @waggle/hive-mind-hooks-openclaw v0.1.0, an OpenClaw silent-capture shim for hive-mind that depends on @waggle/hive-mind-hooks-core and @waggle/hive-mind-shim-core, exposing a CLI binary (openclaw-hooks) and an in-process handler export, built with TypeScript and tested with Vitest.
nodes.languageNotes: Declares both a main entry and a named ./handler export for the in-process hook file that OpenClaw dynamically imports at runtime.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the hive-mind-hooks-openclaw package, extending the monorepo base tsconfig with project references and build output settings for compiling the hook installer and in-process handler.

nodes.name: tsconfig.test.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for test files in the hive-mind-hooks-openclaw package, extending the main tsconfig and including test source files for Vitest type-checking.
